guide.title: 参与前安全检查
guide.description: 核对官方域名后再操作。请使用专用的独立空投钱包，任何时候都不要输入助记词或私钥。任何要求你输入助记词、私钥或向个人地址转账的页面都是骗局。
guide.done_when: 已确认官方域名，并准备好专用的独立空投钱包。

guide.title: Join the Blackboard Waitlist
guide.description: Go to the Blackboard waitlist page and sign up with a Google or X account. Your rank updates live, and higher ranked users reach Alpha sooner.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Follow Blackboard and Post the Referral Tweet
guide.description: Link your X account in the waitlist task list, follow Blackboard , and then post the referral tweet the page generates. Blackboard verifies both before crediting the task, which is worth 60 points.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Share Your Invite Link
guide.description: Copy the invite link from your waitlist dashboard. Every friend who joins through it adds 30 points to your score. Invite codes also circulate through partners and selected communities.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Create Your Blackboard Account
guide.description: When access opens, sign in at the Blackboard terminal with Google, Apple or email, or connect a wallet you already use. Social login creates an embedded self-custodial wallet, so you hold the keys either way.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Deposit USDC to Your Blackboard Wallet
guide.description: Open Deposit from the Portfolio screen, choose the asset and network, then send funds to the address shown. Picking the wrong network can lose the deposit permanently. Instant and free: USDC on Arbitrum, Polygon, HyperEVM or Solana Routed for a fee shown before you confirm: USDC on Ethereum, Base or BNB Chain Also accepted: USDT credited as USDC, $10 minimum You can buy USDC on Bybit and withdraw
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Trade Perpetual Futures
guide.description: Open the Trade tab and pick a market. Volume lands on two protocols that each run their own reward programs, so one position builds history in more than one place.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Invite Traders From Inside the Terminal
guide.description: Grab your referral code from My Page once you are trading. You earn 10% of the Blackboard fee on every trade your invitees make. Self-referral is banned and rebates can be clawed back.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。
